note: Merit and named-award data compiled from each school's official financial-aid / scholarships / honors-college pages, July-August 2026. Every value below has an inline source. Need-based aid lives on the Aid & Outcomes tab.

mit.note: MIT aid is 100% need-based. "Our scholarships are awarded based solely on financial need."

carnegie-mellon.note: Presidential Scholarship discontinued for incoming students from 2019-20. FAFSA + CSS, no separate app, 8 semesters. CMU is essentially need-based.

cornell.note: "No merit aid or athletic scholarships are awarded at Cornell."

purdue.flagship_amount: Full COA for BS + master's/MBA/doctoral + one study abroad
purdue.auto_criteria: Trustees $16k/yr nonres / $10k res; Presidential $10k nonres / $4k res; automatic, no separate app; Nov 1 deadline; renew 3.00 GPA. About 15% of applicants get merit.
purdue.oos_specific: Trustees & Presidential explicitly larger for out-of-state students.
purdue.note: Beering is invite-only via Honors College Nov 1 application; Trustees & Presidential are automatic.

penn-state.auto_criteria: Provost Academic Award (non-PA) / Penn State Academic Award (PA) $1,500-$3,200/yr — awarded automatically. Roughly 1 in 4 undergrads get a University scholarship.
penn-state.oos_specific: Provost Academic Award is for non-PA residents at University Park.
penn-state.note: Schreyer merit award is only for admitted Schreyer Honors Scholars; Schreyer admission is separate and highly selective.

rit.auto_criteria: No separate app; automatic; auto-renewable. 100% of students receive merit funding. ED1/EA 11/1, ED2 1/1, RD 1/15.
rit.note: One of the most broadly generous merit programs on the list. 100% receive some merit award.

illinois-tech.flagship: Camras Scholars (also Crown, Duchossois, Leadership Academy)
illinois-tech.flagship_amount: Full tuition, up to 4 yrs (5 for Arch)
illinois-tech.ed_specific: Camras deadline Nov 15 — must apply ED or EA. Full-tuition scholars ≈4-5% of class.
illinois-tech.auto_criteria: Heald Scholarship $80,000-$120,000 total — all domestic first-years auto-considered, no application.
named_awards: Illinois Tech Purpose — zero-tuition (IL residents, AGI ≤$75k)
illinois-tech.note: Multiple full-tuition pathways with published deadlines. Camras is the marquee award but Heald covers most others automatically.

wpi.flagship_amount: Varies; min $25,000/yr guaranteed for IB Diploma ≥40 (4 yrs)
wpi.ed_specific: All ED admits from fall 2026 onward receive min $25,000/yr merit ($100k over 4 yrs). Not combinable with the Innovation Award.
wpi.auto_criteria: Presidential is automatic with application (no extra app except FIRST/VEX/REC).
wpi.note: The ED-only $25k+ minimum is unusually generous. Applying ED at WPI has a very real financial upside.

rpi.auto_criteria: No student application — high school nominates one junior; nominations due May 1.
rpi.note: The Medal requires a school nomination in junior year — talk to your counselor early.

georgia-tech.auto_criteria: Apply by Early Action; no separate app; semifinalist interviews late Jan, Stamps Weekend mid-March.
georgia-tech.oos_specific: OOS Stamps recipients get a tuition waiver to the in-state rate.
named_awards: No other significant merit programs published with amounts
georgia-tech.note: Georgia Tech is otherwise essentially need-only. Stamps is a needle-mover if you win it.

uiuc.flagship_amount: Up to full COA, 4 yrs (3.0 GPA)
uiuc.auto_criteria: Illinois application serves as the scholarship application. No separate app.
uiuc.oos_specific: Illinois Achievement Scholarship — $10,000 for non-resident freshmen with need.
named_awards: Anthony & Blackshear — full tuition + fees (IL only)
uiuc.note: Multiple pathways to full tuition. Even OOS students have a $10k safety net if need-eligible.

michigan.flagship_amount: LSA up to $15k/yr in-state, $25k/yr OOS; Stamps $20k/yr (18 freshmen/yr)
michigan.auto_criteria: Only ~40 LSA merit awards/yr; automatic from LSA application; Nov 1 EA gives best consideration.
michigan.oos_specific: LSA merit is higher for OOS ($25k vs $15k/yr).
michigan.note: For OOS students especially: Michigan is not a merit-aid destination. Apply for financial reasons only if you meet need thresholds.

johns-hopkins.flagship_amount: ~2/3 of tuition (English page: "significant portion of annual tuition")
johns-hopkins.auto_criteria: Less than 20 freshmen each year; all applicants auto-considered, no app; notified with admission; renew 3.0 GPA.
named_awards: Charles R. Westgate Engineering Scholarship (4 yrs, Whiting School)
johns-hopkins.note: JHU is essentially need-only for most students. Hodson goes to fewer than 20 freshmen a year.

maryland.flagship_amount: Up to full tuition, fees, housing, food + book allowance
maryland.ed_specific: Nov 1 EA required for Banneker/Key consideration.
maryland.auto_criteria: President's $2,000-$20,000/yr for 4 yrs (in- and out-of-state); Dean's $1,500 or $4,500/yr for 2 yrs (in-state only, ~400/yr, not renewable).
maryland.oos_specific: President's open to OOS students; Dean's is in-state only.
maryland.note: EA deadline is a hard gate — miss it and you're out for merit.

northeastern.auto_criteria: General merit considers all applicants meeting RD deadline Jan 1, no separate app. No dollar amounts published.
named_awards: Torch Scholars (full tuition/fees/housing/meals + Summer Immersion; requires non-family nomination)
northeastern.note: Third-party sources put general merit in the $10k-$30k/yr range, but that's not on Northeastern's official page.

ohio-state.flagship_amount: Full COA + up to $5,000 enrichment, 8 semesters
ohio-state.auto_criteria: Separate app: admission by Nov 1, scholarship by Nov 9; essay + video; renew 3.4/3.5. National Buckeye (non-Ohio) up to $13,500/yr; Maximus/Provost/Trustees $1k-$3k/yr auto-awarded.
named_awards: President's Ohio (full COA + $5k; ACT 36 or SAT 1600 single sitting, Ohio residents, automatic)
Land Grant Opportunity (full COA, 88 Ohio students/yr)
ohio-state.note: For OOS students: National Buckeye is essentially automatic and materially reduces cost.

nc-state.flagship_amount: ≈$129k in-state / ≈$244k OOS over 4 yrs (tuition, fees, room/board, books, travel, computer, enrichment)
nc-state.auto_criteria: ~38/yr, any discipline; semifinalists get guaranteed University Honors Program invitation.
nc-state.oos_specific: Park value is scaled up for OOS (≈$244k).
nc-state.note: Park is extremely selective but comprehensive. Goodnight is a strong NC-STEM alternative.

unc-chapel-hill.auto_criteria: 68 new scholars for the Class of 2030; separate nomination/application. UNC Academic Scholarships ($3k up to full COA) auto-considered.
unc-chapel-hill.oos_specific: Non-residents receiving a full tuition/fees/housing/meals scholarship are charged tuition at the NC resident rate.
named_awards: Robertson Scholars (8 semesters full tuition, room & board, most fees + 3 summers, study abroad)
unc-chapel-hill.note: Morehead-Cain and Robertson are marquee scholarships nationally. Non-residents pay in-state tuition if awarded.

virginia-tech.flagship_amount: Estimated cost of attendance for 4 yrs, filling in after other scholarships
virginia-tech.ed_specific: Requires Nov 15 EA application (later applicants ineligible); recruitment apps Sept 15-Jan 7 via Scholarship Central (66656).
virginia-tech.oos_specific: Presidential Scholarship Initiative is Virginia-resident only; Pamplin Leadership limited to Virginia public high schools.
named_awards: Pamplin Leadership Award $5,000 (≤40 Virginia public-HS students, ≥3.8 GPA)
Calhoun / McNamara / Alumni Presidential / Townsend-Crews / Spratley (amounts unpublished)
virginia-tech.generosity: Modest broadly, generous for Honors/Stamps selectees
virginia-tech.note: Nov 15 EA is a hard gate. For non-Virginia residents, Stamps is essentially the only big-dollar route.

florida.auto_criteria: Automatic, no separate app, no extra materials. Presidential $5k/yr, Gold $8k/yr, Platinum $10k/yr — awarded automatically to ~10% of admits. No pre-set criteria.
florida.oos_specific: OOS tuition waivers: Alumni up to $8k/yr, Sunshine up to $16k/yr, Gator Nation $20k/yr. Voided if residency becomes in-state.
named_awards: Benacquisto (state; covers COA minus Bright Futures + qualifying National Merit; UF's $500/yr NM Scholarship qualifies if UF named first choice by May 31)
Machen Florida Opportunity Scholars (full package, first-gen, income <$55k)
florida.note: For OOS applicants: Sunshine + Gator Nation waivers can materially close the gap with in-state tuition.

olin.auto_criteria: Awarded to all students; no separate app.
olin.note: Every Olin admit gets the base $10k/yr Olin Tuition Scholarship — no exceptions. (Reference "half tuition" is outdated.)

rose-hulman.auto_criteria: Rose-Hulman Merit Scholarship — all admits auto-considered (amount unpublished), renewable 4 yrs with no GPA requirement.
rose-hulman.note: Robotics scholarships are unusually generous — if applicant is on a FIRST or VEX team, worth verifying eligibility.

carleton.note: "The vast majority of our grants and scholarship are need-based." Merit is small and eligibility-based.

swarthmore.flagship_amount: Minimum annual grant of full tuition
named_awards: Philip Evans Scholars (merit + one-time computer allowance up to $1,500 + annual opportunity grant; may rise to full tuition, fees, room and board with need)
swarthmore.generosity: Modest (few awards, each at full-tuition level)
swarthmore.note: Swarthmore is often reported as need-only, but McCabe is genuinely merit-based and full-tuition. Selection details not published on the fetched page.

uc-berkeley.auto_criteria: Regents' and Chancellor's Scholarship is Berkeley's most prestigious merit scholarship, automatically considered from the UC application. Amount varies with financial need.
uc-berkeley.oos_specific: Blue and Gold Opportunity Plan is California-residents-only.
uc-berkeley.note: Berkeley is essentially need-only for OOS students. The Regents' Scholarship offers small merit amounts but no full-ride equivalent. No ED bonus (Berkeley has no ED).

uw-seattle.auto_criteria: Purple & Gold Scholarship auto-considered from admission application; renewable for 4 years.
uw-seattle.oos_specific: Husky Promise (in-state Washington residents only) covers full tuition + fees for Pell-eligible families.
uw-seattle.note: UW meets only 74% of demonstrated need for OOS students — merit is scarce and financially not decisive for a NC family.

ut-austin.flagship_amount: $128,000 total over 4 yrs (essentially full ride) + enrichment funding
ut-austin.auto_criteria: Automatic consideration for all applicants who complete the ApplyTexas/Common App by Dec 1 deadline; separate scholarship essay required for Forty Acres.
ut-austin.oos_specific: Forty Acres is OOS-eligible; Texas Advance Commitment is Texas-residents-only.
ut-austin.generosity: Modest broadly, generous for Forty Acres selectees
ut-austin.note: For OOS students, Forty Acres is essentially the only big-dollar path. Very competitive — a few dozen per year.

duke.flagship_amount: ≈$315,000 over 4 yrs (full tuition + summer stipends + enrichment)
duke.auto_criteria: No separate application for Duke-administered merit — all admits are auto-considered for A.B. Duke, Robertson, and Benjamin N. Duke Scholarships.
named_awards: Robertson Scholars — full-ride across Duke AND UNC (joint program)
Benjamin N. Duke Scholarship (Carolinas students, full tuition + stipends)
duke.note: Robertson is a marquee scholarship nationally — the only cross-institutional full-ride between Duke and UNC. A.B. Duke has no separate application.

texas-am.auto_criteria: Multiple auto-award tiers via TAMU application; Regents' Scholars covers full COA for first-gen
texas-am.oos_specific: Terry Scholarship & Regents' available for Texas residents; OOS limited
texas-am.note: Aggie network scholarships are strong for in-state; OOS students have limited merit.

ut-dallas.flagship_amount: ~$310,000 total for non-Texas students (full COA + enrichment)
ut-dallas.auto_criteria: Academic Excellence Scholarship (AES) auto-awarded; 976 no-need first-years got merit averaging $10,636
ut-dallas.oos_specific: McDermott is OOS-eligible; AES/NMS also open
ut-dallas.note: UTD is one of the best value picks in Texas — merit is auto-considered and generous for OOS.

kettering.auto_criteria: Robotics competition applicants get $5k/yr with Feb 15 deadline; GM STEM Opportunity covers remaining tuition
kettering.note: Co-op earnings (up to $70k) + robotics scholarship stack meaningfully — Kettering is a real value.

michigan-dearborn.auto_criteria: Automatic non-resident merit up to $12,500/yr; Tuition Differential award ($17,232) requires Michigan address
michigan-dearborn.oos_specific: Non-resident merit is auto-considered; Tuition Differential is in-state only
michigan-dearborn.note: Auto-merit for OOS partially offsets the $50k+ OOS COA.
